summary.text: Heath VanNatter is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 38, assumed office in 2010, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Nate Stout (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Heath VanNatter was born and raised in Howard County and is a graduate of Northwestern High School.

His professional experience includes owning and operating VanNatter Construction, serving as president of the Howard County Home Builders Association, and serving on the boards of directors of the Indiana Builders Association and the National Association of Home Builders.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists VanNatter as chair of the Employment, Labor and Pensions Committee and a member of the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development and Public Policy committees.
